title.ur: Mukaalma 1: Meray ghar walon ki tasveer

intro.en: Layla shows her friend Noura a photo of her family. Learn the words for father, mother, grandfather, grandmother, brother and sister, and how to ask «مَنْ هَذا؟» (who is this?).
intro.ur: Layla apni saheli Noura ko apne ghar walon ki tasveer dikhati hai. Walid, walida, dada, dadi, bhai aur behan ke alfaaz seekhein, aur «مَنْ هَذا؟» (yeh kaun hai?) poochna seekhein.
intro.ar: تُري لَيْلى صَديقَتَها نورَةَ صورَةَ أُسْرَتِها. تَتَعَلَّمُ: والِد، والِدَة، جَدّ، جَدَّة، أَخ، أُخْت، وَكَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ «مَنْ هَذا؟».

dialogue.en: Peace be upon you, Layla.
dialogue.ur: Aap par salamati ho Layla.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلامُ يا نورَة. هَذِهِ صورَةُ أُسْرَتي.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalaykumu s-salāmu yā Nūrah. hādhihi ṣūratu usratī
dialogue.en: And upon you be peace, Noura. This is a picture of my family.
dialogue.ur: Aap par salamati ho Noura. Yeh meri family ki tasveer hai.

dialogue.ar: صورَةٌ جَميلَةٌ! مَنْ هَذا يا لَيْلى؟
dialogue.tr: ṣūratun jamīlah! man hādhā yā Laylā?
dialogue.en: A lovely picture! Who is this, Layla?
dialogue.ur: Kya pyaari tasveer hai! Layla, yeh kaun hain?

dialogue.ar: هَذا والِدي. اسْمُهُ كَريم، هُوَ طَبيب.
dialogue.tr: hādhā wālidī. ismuhu Karīm, huwa ṭabīb
dialogue.en: This is my father. His name is Karim, he is a doctor.
dialogue.ur: Yeh mere walid hain. Unka naam Karim hai, woh doctor hain.

dialogue.en: And who is this?
dialogue.ur: Aur yeh kaun hain?

dialogue.ar: وَهَذِهِ والِدَتي. اسْمُها هُدى، هِيَ مُعَلِّمَة.
dialogue.tr: wa hādhihi wālidatī. ismuhā Hudā, hiya muʿallimah
dialogue.en: And this is my mother. Her name is Huda, she is a teacher.
dialogue.ur: Aur yeh meri walida hain. Unka naam Huda hai, woh ustani hain.

dialogue.en: And this one? Is he your brother?
dialogue.ur: Aur yeh? Kya yeh aap ke bhai hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، هَذا أَخي الكَبيرُ بِلال. هُوَ طالِب.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, hādhā akhī l-kabīru Bilāl. huwa ṭālib
dialogue.en: Yes, this is my big brother Bilal. He is a student.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, yeh mere bade bhai Bilal hain. Woh talib-e-ilm hain.

dialogue.tr: wa man hādhā wa man hādhihi?
dialogue.en: And who is this man and who is this lady?
dialogue.ur: Aur yeh kaun hain aur yeh kaun hain?

dialogue.ar: هَذا جَدّي حُسَيْن، وَهَذِهِ جَدَّتي رُقَيَّة.
dialogue.tr: hādhā jaddī Ḥusayn, wa hādhihi jaddatī Ruqayyah
dialogue.en: This is my grandfather Husayn, and this is my grandmother Ruqayyah.
dialogue.ur: Yeh mere dada Husayn hain, aur yeh meri dadi Ruqayyah hain.

dialogue.en: Masha Allah! Your family is beautiful.
dialogue.ur: Masha Allah! Aap ki family bohat khoobsurat hai.

dialogue.en: Thank you, Noura.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya Noura.

q.ur: «والِد» ka matlab kya hai?
«جَدَّة» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Your friend shows you a photo of a man. How do you ask who he is?
q.ur: Dost ek mard ki tasveer dikhaye. Aap kaise poochenge ke yeh kaun hai?
q.ar: أَراكَ صَديقُكَ صورَةَ رَجُلٍ. كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ؟

q.ur: "Tasveer" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما نُعَلِّقُهُ عَلى الجِدارِ وَفيهِ وُجوهٌ؟

q.ur: "Khandaan" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني الأَبَ وَالأُمَّ وَالأَوْلاد؟

intro.en: Hisham and Salma look at a family tree. Add «ـهُ» (-hu, his) to a word: والِد → والِدُهُ (his father). Learn uncle, aunt, son and daughter too.
intro.ur: Hisham aur Salma ek shajre (family tree) ko dekhte hain. Lafz ke aakhir mein «ـهُ» (-hu, uska) lagane se «uska» ka matlab banta hai: والِد → والِدُهُ (uske walid). Chacha/mamu (عَمّ), phuphi/khala (عَمَّة), beta (ابْن) aur beti (ابْنَة) bhi seekhein.
intro.ar: يَنْظُرُ هِشامٌ وَسَلْمى إلى شَجَرَةِ العائِلَة. أَضِفْ «ـهُ» إلى الكَلِمَةِ لِتَدُلَّ عَلى الغائِب: والِد ← والِدُهُ. وَتَتَعَلَّمُ العَمَّ وَالعَمَّةَ وَالابْنَ وَالابْنَة.

dialogue.ar: يا سَلْمى، ما هَذِهِ؟ هَلْ هِيَ شَجَرَةٌ؟
dialogue.tr: yā Salmā, mā hādhihi? hal hiya shajarah?
dialogue.en: Salma, what is this? Is it a tree?
dialogue.ur: Salma, yeh kya hai? Kya yeh ek shajar hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، هَذِهِ شَجَرَةُ أُسْرَةِ جَدّي مَنْصور.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, hādhihi shajaratu usrati jaddī Manṣūr
dialogue.en: Yes, this is the family tree of my grandfather Mansour.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, yeh mere dada Mansoor ke khandaan ka shajra hai.

dialogue.en: Very nice! Who is this?
dialogue.ur: Bohat khoob! Yeh kaun hain?

dialogue.en: This is his father, Hamid.
dialogue.ur: Yeh unke walid Hamid hain.

dialogue.en: And who is this?
dialogue.ur: Aur yeh kaun hain?

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ والِدَتُهُ زُهْرَة، وَهَذا جَدُّهُ إِدْريس.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi wālidatuhu Zuhrah, wa hādhā jadduhu Idrīs
dialogue.en: This is his mother, Zuhra, and this is his grandfather, Idris.
dialogue.ur: Yeh unki walida Zuhra hain, aur yeh unke dada Idris hain.

dialogue.en: And this man, who is he?
dialogue.ur: Aur yeh sahab, yeh kaun hain?

dialogue.ar: هَذا عَمُّهُ يَحْيى، وَهَذِهِ عَمَّتُهُ سُعاد.
dialogue.tr: hādhā ʿammuhu Yaḥyā, wa hādhihi ʿammatuhu Suʿād
dialogue.en: This is his uncle, Yahya, and this is his aunt, Suad.
dialogue.ur: Yeh unke chacha Yahya hain, aur yeh unki phuphi Suad hain.

dialogue.en: And this one? Is he his son?
dialogue.ur: Aur yeh? Kya yeh unke beta hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، هَذا ابْنُهُ سَليم، وَهُوَ والِدي. وَهَذا ابْنُهُ ماجِد.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, hādhā ibnuhu Salīm, wa huwa wālidī. wa hādhā ibnuhu Mājid
dialogue.en: Yes, this is his son Salim, who is my father. And this is his son Majid.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, yeh unke beta Salim hain, jo mere walid hain. Aur yeh unke beta Majid hain.

dialogue.en: And who is this?
dialogue.ur: Aur yeh kaun hain?

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ ابْنَتُهُ مَيْمونَة، وَهَذِهِ ابْنَتُهُ هالَة.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi ibnatuhu Maymūnah, wa hādhihi ibnatuhu Hālah
dialogue.en: This is his daughter, Maymuna, and this is his daughter, Hala.
dialogue.ur: Yeh unki beti Maymuna hain, aur yeh unki beti Hala hain.

dialogue.en: Masha Allah! A beautiful tree.
dialogue.ur: Masha Allah! Bohat khoobsurat shajra.

vocab.ur: kya yeh darakht hai? (haan/nahin wala sawal)

q.ur: «عَمّ» ka matlab kya hai?
«ابْنَة» ka matlab kya hai?
"Uske walid" Arabi mein kaise kahenge?
"Darakht" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما تُرْسَمُ فيهِ أَسْماءُ أَفْرادِ العائِلَة؟

q.ur: «هَلْ هَذِهِ شَجَرَةٌ؟» ka jawab "haan" kaise denge?
q.ar: سَأَلَكَ أَحَدُهُمْ: «هَلْ هَذِهِ شَجَرَةٌ؟». جَوابُ المُوافَقَةِ هُوَ:

title.ur: Mukaalma 3: Ghar mein Fajr ki azaan

intro.en: It is the time of the Fajr adhan. The father asks «أَيْنَ؟» (where?) and the mother tells him where the children are. Learn the words for mosque, room, bathroom, praying, reading and making wudu.
intro.ur: Fajr ki azaan ka waqt hai. Abbu poochte hain «أَيْنَ؟» (kahan?) aur ammi batati hain ke bachche kahan hain. Masjid, kamra, ghusalkhana, namaz parhna, Quran parhna aur wudu karna jaise alfaaz seekhein.
intro.ar: حانَ وَقْتُ أَذانِ الفَجْر. يَسْأَلُ الأَبُ «أَيْنَ؟» وَتُخْبِرُهُ الأُمُّ بِمَكانِ كُلِّ واحِدٍ مِنَ الأَوْلاد. تَتَعَلَّمُ: المَسْجِد، الغُرْفَة، الحَمّام، يُصَلّي، يَقْرَأُ، يَتَوَضَّأ.

dialogue.ar: اسْمَعْ يا أَبا نُعْمان، إِنَّهُ أَذانُ الفَجْرِ.
dialogue.tr: isʿam yā Abā Nuʿmān, innahu adhānu l-fajr
dialogue.en: Listen, Abu Numan, it is the Fajr adhan.
dialogue.ur: Suniye Abu Numan, yeh Fajr ki azaan hai.

dialogue.ar: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ! أَيْنَ الأَوْلادُ يا أُمَّ نُعْمان؟
dialogue.tr: Allāhu akbar! ayna l-awlād yā Umma Nuʿmān?
dialogue.en: Allah is the Greatest! Where are the children, Umm Numan?
dialogue.ur: Allahu Akbar! Bachche kahan hain, Umm Numan?

dialogue.en: Numan is making wudu in the bathroom now.
dialogue.ur: Numan abhi ghusalkhane mein wudu kar raha hai.

dialogue.en: And where is Hassan?
dialogue.ur: Aur Hassan kahan hai?

dialogue.en: Hassan is reading the Quran in his room.
dialogue.ur: Hassan apne kamre mein Quran parh raha hai.

dialogue.en: And where is Unaysa?
dialogue.ur: Aur Unaisa kahan hai?

dialogue.en: Unaysa is praying in the prayer room.
dialogue.ur: Unaisa namaz ki jagah par namaz parh rahi hai.

dialogue.tr: wa ayna n-naẓẓārah? ana lā arāhā
dialogue.en: And where are the glasses? I cannot see them.
dialogue.ur: Aur aynak kahan hai? Mujhe nazar nahin aa rahi.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلْ يا أَبي، هَذِهِ هِيَ النَّظّارَةُ.
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍal yā abī, hādhihi hiya n-naẓẓārah
dialogue.en: Here you are, father, these are the glasses.
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye abbu, yeh rahi aynak.

dialogue.en: And where is the coat?
dialogue.ur: Aur coat kahan hai?

dialogue.en: Here you are, father, this is your coat.
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye abbu, yeh aap ka coat hai.

dialogue.ar: جَزاكُمُ اللهُ خَيْراً! هَيّا بِنا إِلى المَسْجِدِ.
dialogue.tr: jazākumu llāhu khayran! hayyā binā ilā l-masjid
dialogue.en: May Allah reward you! Let us go to the mosque.
dialogue.ur: Allah aap sab ko jazaye khair de! Chalein masjid chalte hain.

dialogue.en: Let us go, father.
dialogue.ur: Chalein abbu.

q.ur: «أَيْنَ» ka matlab kya hai?
"Masjid" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني المَكانَ الَّذي نُصَلّي فيهِ الجَماعَة؟

q.ur: «يَتَوَضَّأُ» ka matlab kya hai?

options: He makes wudu / Woh wudu karta hai
He prays / Woh namaz parhta hai

q.en: Where is Hassan in the dialogue?
q.ur: Mukaalme mein Hassan kahan hai?

options: في الغُرْفَة (in the room / kamre mein)
في الحَمّام (in the bathroom / ghusalkhane mein)
في المُصَلّى (in the prayer place / namaz ki jagah)
في المَسْجِد (in the mosque / masjid mein)

q.ur: "Aynak (chashma)" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما نَلْبَسُهُ عَلى العَيْنَيْنِ لِنَرى جَيِّداً؟

title.ur: Sunne ki mashq aur ginti 6 se 10

intro.en: Listen and tap the picture you hear. Then learn the numbers six to ten by counting pens: سِتَّة، سَبْعَة، ثَمانِيَة، تِسْعَة، عَشَرَة.
intro.ur: Dhyan se suniye aur sahi tasveer chuniye. Phir qalam ginte hue 6 se 10 tak ginti seekhein: سِتَّة (6), سَبْعَة (7), ثَمانِيَة (8), تِسْعَة (9), عَشَرَة (10).
intro.ar: اسْتَمِعْ وَاخْتَرِ الصّورَةَ الَّتي تَسْمَعُها. ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمِ الأَعْدادَ مِنْ سِتَّةٍ إلى عَشَرَةٍ بِعَدِّ الأَقْلام: سِتَّة، سَبْعَة، ثَمانِيَة، تِسْعَة، عَشَرَة.

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 6 hai?
«ثَمانِيَة» kaun sa adad hai?
Kaun sa lafz 10 hai?
«سَبْعَة» kaun sa adad hai?
Kaun sa lafz 9 hai?

title.en: Grammar: where, who, he and she

intro.en: Ask «أَيْنَ؟» (where?) and answer with «في» (in). Ask «مَنْ؟» (who?) and use هُوَ (he) and هِيَ (she). For a man the verb starts with ي: يُصَلّي (he prays); for a woman with ت: تُصَلّي (she prays).
intro.ur: «أَيْنَ؟» (kahan?) poochein aur «في» (mein) se jawab dein. «مَنْ؟» (kaun?) poochein aur هُوَ (woh, mard) aur هِيَ (woh, aurat) istemal karein. Mard ke liye fe'l ي se shuru hota hai: يُصَلّي (woh namaz parhta hai); aurat ke liye ت se: تُصَلّي (woh namaz parhti hai).
intro.ar: نَسْأَلُ بِـ«أَيْنَ؟» وَنُجيبُ بِـ«في». وَنَسْأَلُ بِـ«مَنْ؟» وَنَسْتَعْمِلُ هُوَ وَهِيَ. يَبْدَأُ فِعْلُ الرَّجُلِ بِالياءِ: يُصَلّي، وَيَبْدَأُ فِعْلُ المَرْأَةِ بِالتّاءِ: تُصَلّي.

vocab.en: Where is the coat? — Here is the coat.
vocab.ur: Coat kahan hai? — Yeh raha coat.

vocab.en: Where is the room? — Here is the room.
vocab.ur: Kamra kahan hai? — Yeh raha kamra.

vocab.en: Saeed is in the room reading the Quran.
vocab.ur: Saeed kamre mein Quran parh raha hai.

vocab.en: Saeeda is in the room reading the Quran.
vocab.ur: Saeeda kamre mein Quran parh rahi hai.

vocab.ar: مَنْ هَذا؟ — هَذا والِدي عَدْنانُ، هُوَ مُهَنْدِسٌ.
vocab.tr: man hādhā? — hādhā wālidī ʿAdnān, huwa muhandis
vocab.en: Who is this? — This is my father Adnan, he is an engineer.
vocab.ur: Yeh kaun hai? — Yeh mere walid Adnan hain, woh engineer hain.

vocab.ar: هَذا والِدي عَدْنانُ. هَذا والِدُهُ عَدْنانُ.
vocab.tr: hādhā wālidī ʿAdnān. hādhā wālidu-hu ʿAdnān
vocab.en: This is my father Adnan. This is his father Adnan.
vocab.ur: Yeh mere walid Adnan hain. Yeh unke walid Adnan hain.
woh (mard): wudu karta hai, namaz parhta hai, parhta hai
woh (aurat): wudu karti hai, namaz parhti hai, parhti hai

vocab.en: he is: a doctor, a teacher, an engineer, a student
she is: a doctor, a teacher, an engineer, a student

q.ur: Kaun sa sawali lafz "kahan" hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةِ سُؤالٍ نَسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ المَكان؟

q.en: Fill in: سَعيدٌ في الغُرْفَةِ ___ القُرْآنَ. (he reads)
q.ur: Khali jagah bharein: سَعيدٌ في الغُرْفَةِ ___ القُرْآنَ. (woh parhta hai)

q.en: Fill in: سَعيدَةُ في المُصَلّى ___. (she prays)
q.ur: Khali jagah bharein: سَعيدَةُ في المُصَلّى ___. (woh namaz parhti hai)
"Woh (aurat)" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ضَميرَ الغائِبَةِ المُؤَنَّث؟

q.en: How do you say "she is a doctor"?
q.ur: "Woh (aurat) doctor hai" kaise kahenge?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَقولُ عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ إِنَّها طَبيبَة؟

intro.en: The letter ع is a deep sound made from the throat. It is different from أ (hamza). Listen and repeat: عُمَر، عَمّار، عَلَيْكُم، عَبْدُ الله، العَبّاس، عَمُّهُ، سَعْد.
intro.ur: Harf ع halq (gale) ki gehrai se nikalta hai. Yeh أ (hamza) se mukhtalif hai. Suniye aur dohraiye: عُمَر، عَمّار، عَلَيْكُم، عَبْدُ الله، العَبّاس، عَمُّهُ، سَعْد. Do awazon mein farq pehchanne ki mashq karein.
intro.ar: الحَرْفُ ع صَوْتٌ عَميقٌ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الحَلْق، وَهُوَ يَخْتَلِفُ عَنْ الهَمْزَةِ أ. اسْتَمِعْ وَكَرِّرْ: عُمَر، عَمّار، عَلَيْكُم، عَبْدُ الله، العَبّاس، عَمُّهُ، سَعْد.

q.en: Which letter makes the deep throat sound?
q.ur: Kaun sa harf halq ki gehri awaz deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يَخْرُجُ صَوْتُهُ العَميقُ مِنَ الحَلْق؟

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz ع se shuru hota hai?
Kaun sa lafz أ (hamza) se shuru hota hai?

q.en: Which word has ع in the middle?
q.ur: Kis lafz ke beech mein ع hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها الحَرْفُ ع في الوَسَط؟

q.ur: «عَلَيْكُم» ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: Practise with a partner. Ask where someone is: «أَيْنَ أَحْمَدُ؟» and answer: «أَحْمَدُ في المَسْجِدِ يُصَلّي.» Then ask «مَنْ هَذا؟» and say who the person is and what he or she does.
intro.ur: Kisi saathi ke saath mashq karein. Poochein: «أَيْنَ أَحْمَدُ؟» (Ahmad kahan hai?) aur jawab dein: «أَحْمَدُ في المَسْجِدِ يُصَلّي.» (Ahmad masjid mein namaz parh raha hai). Phir «مَنْ هَذا؟» poochein aur batayein ke woh kaun hai aur kya karta hai.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ: اسْأَلْ عَنْ مَكانِ شَخْصٍ «أَيْنَ أَحْمَدُ؟» وَأَجِبْ «أَحْمَدُ في المَسْجِدِ يُصَلّي.» ثُمَّ اسْأَلْ «مَنْ هَذا؟» وَقُلْ مَنْ هُوَ وَماذا يَعْمَل.

q.en: Someone asks «أَيْنَ أَحْمَدُ؟». A good answer is:
q.ur: Koi poochhe «أَيْنَ أَحْمَدُ؟» to achha jawab:
q.ar: سَأَلَكَ أَحَدُهُمْ: «أَيْنَ أَحْمَدُ؟». ما الجَوابُ المُناسِب؟

q.en: How do you ask "Who is this?" about a man?
q.ur: Mard ke baare mein "yeh kaun hai?" kaise poochenge?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ: مَنْ هُوَ؟

q.en: Which sentence is right for a girl called Zaynab in the room reading the Quran?
q.ur: Kamre mein Quran parhti hui Zainab ke liye kaun sa jumla sahi hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ صَحيحَةٌ عَنْ فَتاةٍ اسْمُها زَيْنَب في الغُرْفَةِ تَقْرَأُ القُرْآن؟

q.en: «هَذا والِدي عَلِيٌّ، هُوَ مُهَنْدِسٌ.» What does it say?
q.ur: «هَذا والِدي عَلِيٌّ، هُوَ مُهَنْدِسٌ.» is mein kya kaha gaya?
q.ar: «هَذا والِدي عَلِيٌّ، هُوَ مُهَنْدِسٌ.» ماذا تَقول؟

options: This is my father Ali, he is an engineer / Yeh mere walid Ali hain, woh engineer hain
This is my mother Ali, she is a doctor / Yeh meri walida hain, woh doctor hain
This is my brother Ali, he is a student / Yeh mere bhai hain, woh talib-e-ilm hain
Where is my father? / Mere walid kahan hain?

q.en: To say "This is my mother Khadija" you say:
q.ur: "Yeh meri walida Khadija hain" kehne ke liye aap kahenge:

intro.en: Look at the pictures, listen and read the words for the family: والِد، والِدَة، أَخ، أُخْت، ابْن، ابْنَة، عَمّ، عَمَّة، جَدّ، جَدَّة. Then match words and find the odd one out. Words for women often end in ـة.
intro.ur: Tasveerein dekhiye, suniye aur khandaan ke alfaaz parhiye: والِد، والِدَة، أَخ، أُخْت، ابْن، ابْنَة، عَمّ، عَمَّة، جَدّ، جَدَّة. Phir alfaaz milayein aur alag lafz dhundein. Aurat ke alfaaz aksar ـة par khatam hote hain.
intro.ar: انْظُرْ إلى الصُّوَرِ وَاسْتَمِعْ وَاقْرَأْ كَلِماتِ الأُسْرَة: والِد، والِدَة، أَخ، أُخْت، ابْن، ابْنَة، عَمّ، عَمَّة، جَدّ، جَدَّة. ثُمَّ طابِقْ بَيْنَ الكَلِماتِ وَجِدِ الكَلِمَةَ الشّاذَّة. تَنْتَهي كَلِماتُ النِّساءِ غالِباً بِـ ـة.

q.ur: "Behan" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني: بِنْتُ الأَبِ وَالأُمِّ نَفْسِهِما؟

q.ur: "Maa" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?

q.en: Which word is for a woman?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz aurat ke liye hai?

q.en: Read: «فاطِمَةُ في الغُرْفَةِ تُصَلّي.» What is Fatima doing?
q.ur: Parhiye: «فاطِمَةُ في الغُرْفَةِ تُصَلّي.» Fatima kya kar rahi hai?
q.ar: اقْرَأْ: «فاطِمَةُ في الغُرْفَةِ تُصَلّي.» ماذا تَفْعَلُ فاطِمَة؟

options: Reading the Quran / Quran parh rahi hai
Making wudu / Wudu kar rahi hai
Going to the mosque / Masjid ja rahi hai

q.en: Read: «هَذا عَمُّهُ أَحْمَدُ، هُوَ مُهَنْدِسٌ.» Who is Ahmad?
q.ur: Parhiye: «هَذا عَمُّهُ أَحْمَدُ، هُوَ مُهَنْدِسٌ.» Ahmad kaun hai?
q.ar: اقْرَأْ: «هَذا عَمُّهُ أَحْمَدُ، هُوَ مُهَنْدِسٌ.» مَنْ هُوَ أَحْمَد؟

options: His uncle, an engineer / Unke chacha, engineer
His father, a doctor / Unke walid, doctor
His brother, a student / Unke bhai, talib-e-ilm
His grandfather, a teacher / Unke dada, ustaad

title.en: Writing: ب ت ث ط ظ أ
title.ur: Likhna: ب ت ث ط ظ أ

intro.en: Learn to write six letters and how they change at the start, middle and end of a word: ب ت ث (one dot below, two dots above, three dots above) and ط ظ أ. Trace the letters, copy them, and notice the dots.
intro.ur: Chhe haroof likhna seekhein aur dekhein ke lafz ke shuru, beech aur aakhir mein inki shakl kaise badalti hai: ب (neeche ek nuqta), ت (oopar do nuqte), ث (oopar teen nuqte), aur ط ظ أ. Haroof par qalam chalayein, naqal karein aur nuqton par dhyan dein.
intro.ar: تَتَعَلَّمُ كِتابَةَ سِتَّةِ حُروفٍ وَكَيْفَ يَتَغَيَّرُ شَكْلُها في أَوَّلِ الكَلِمَةِ وَوَسَطِها وَآخِرِها: ب ت ث (نُقْطَةٌ تَحْتُ، نُقْطَتانِ فَوْق، ثَلاثُ نُقَطٍ فَوْق) وَ ط ظ أ. تَتَبَّعِ الحُروفَ وَانْسَخْها وَلاحِظِ النُّقَط.

q.en: Which letter has one dot below?
q.ur: Kis harf ke neeche ek nuqta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ فيهِ نُقْطَةٌ واحِدَةٌ تَحْتَه؟

q.en: Which letter has three dots above?
q.ur: Kis harf ke oopar teen nuqte hain?

q.en: Which letter has two dots above?
q.ur: Kis harf ke oopar do nuqte hain?

q.en: Which word contains the letter ظ?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein harf ظ hai?

q.en: What is the first letter of «طالِب»?
q.ur: «طالِب» ka pehla harf kaun sa hai?
